decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9737. Series context: trend strength 0.5447 and seasonal strength 0.1484; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.033); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.565.
